assessment.rationale: Thymic restoration in older adults has no approved or open solution, and nothing approaches the Main KPI of 500,000,000 older adults with a restored thymus. The only registered human programme is TRIIM-X (NCT04375657, phase 2, about 85 participants, growth hormone plus metformin and DHEA, thymic density by MRI/CT), an extension of the 9-man TRIIM pilot whose results were explicitly preliminary and are not independently replicated; its interim reports come from the sponsor (https://classic.clinicaltrials.gov/ct2/show/record/NCT04375657). Regenerative candidates remain earlier: KGF/palifermin is in transplant and MS trials rather than approved for age-related involution, IL-22 and BMP4 are preclinical (https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC8652142/table/T1), and Tolerance Bio's iPSC-derived thymic organoids are preclinical with pre-IND work planned (https://secure.businesswire.com/news/home/20251027232982/en/). No open-source or openly published method restores a human thymus, so this is open work, but tasks replicating TRIIM-style regimens are not new and need their own basis.

additionalSearches.finding: TRIIM-X is a phase 2, ~85-participant, 12-month trial of GH+metformin+DHEA with thymic density as primary outcome; only sponsor-reported interim signals exist, no peer-reviewed results.

additionalSearches.query: thymus regeneration therapy clinical trial older adults 2026 Tolerance Bio Thymmune FOXN1
additionalSearches.finding: Besides TRIIM-X no registered human thymus-regeneration trial found; TECregen is preclinical, Thymofox's site appears down, Thymmune and Vidaregen are early ARPA-backed efforts.

additionalSearches.query: thymic involution reversal approved treatment KGF palifermin IL-22 BMP4 review
additionalSearches.finding: No approved therapy reverses age-related thymic involution; KGF is in clinical trials for other settings, IL-22 and BMP4 are preclinical in thymic epithelial cells.

additionalSearches.query: Tolerance Bio thymus iPSC-derived thymic epithelial cells engineered thymus organoid
additionalSearches.finding: Tolerance Bio reports iPSC-derived thymic organoids educating human T cells in mice, with an allogeneic process and pre-IND studies planned; preclinical, not a restored human thymus.
